followup_rationale: The fixed-length score-vector schema yielded zero valid responses in 20/20 calls. This follow-up uses Ollama JSON mode without an attached schema and accepts only an exact-length integer vector as a root array or a single scores field; all other shapes are rejected and diagnosed only by structural metadata.
scope: Local-only follow-up reranking pilot. No production activation, fallback, source database writes, reindex, remote inference, or threshold fitting.

embedding_model.embedding_inputs: All selected corpus documents and the 10 labeled queries are embedded once, sequentially; context rejections are recorded and never truncated.

reranker.response_format: Ollama format=json. Prompt asks for exactly 20 integer scores 0..100 in candidate order. Accept only a root integer array of length 20 or an object whose sole key is scores with that array; reject other shapes/types/ranges. Rank descending by score; ties keep Nomic candidate order.

corpus.source_mode: SQLite URI mode=ro; vectors are transient in-memory sqlite-vec rows.

selection: Only the 10 pre-existing queries in group covered with a non-empty expected title; no new human judgments and no changes to query/corpus selection.

candidate_generation.expansion: Double K until pool size 20 or min(index rows, 4096).
candidate_generation.reranker_input: Original query plus candidate exact title and first 420 whitespace-normalized text characters. Candidate text is data, not instruction; no tools are available to the model.

scoring.relevance: Binary exact normalized title match to the existing expected_title field.
scoring.primary_comparison: Within each candidate pool, compare Nomic distance order against Qwen reranked order on the same 10 labeled queries. Report reranker metrics both end-to-end (invalid responses count as misses) and conditional on valid responses.

privacy.raw_model_answer: Retain only when it is valid JSON containing exactly the supplied C-label permutation; otherwise retain only response hash and validation status.

interpretation_limits: Only 10 exploratory, hand-authored queries have expected titles; this is not a blind independent gold set.
Exact title match measures retrieval of a known title, not semantic answer quality or citation correctness.
The source slice contains 4,732 rows from a larger local database; results do not generalize to the full database or other profiles.
One deterministic decode per query/pool does not measure run-to-run variance.
Reranking can only reorder candidates present in its pool; candidate recall is reported separately.
No production activation or inference beyond this local pilot is authorized by the result.
